Loaʻa iā ʻoe ka meaʻai nui mai ka ʻai ʻana i ka iʻa i kuke ʻia.(ʻAʻole hōʻike me AppleSkin)
power.origins_backgrounds.shield_prowess: ʻOiai e hoʻohana ana i kahi pale, loaʻa iā ʻoe ka Resistance I.
power.origins_backgrounds.hello_darkness: Ua pale ʻoe i ka hopena pōʻeleʻele.
power.origins_backgrounds.trusty_hoe.des: Loaʻa iā ʻoe kahi hao hao i hoʻoili ʻia i nā hanauna.
power.origins_backgrounds.attack_in_ocea: Aia ma ke kai, ʻoi aku ka wikiwiki o kāu hoʻouka ʻana.
power.origins_backgrounds.eyepatch.name: Paʻi maka

power.origins_backgrounds.sacrifice.desc: ʻO ka mōhai ʻana i nā moa i kou haku hāʻawi iā ʻoe i ka ʻike pālua.
ʻO kāu hoʻomaʻamaʻa me ka pahi kaua hiki iā ʻoe ke hana i ka 5% pōʻino hou i ka wā e hoʻohana ana i kekahi.
power.origins_backgrounds.potion_food.de: Ua ʻai ʻoe i nā lāʻau he nui i kēia manawa he meaʻai a hoʻōla.
